QuestInfo.name: Gold Richie's Packages
QuestInfo.0: Gold Richie has a job for you. Go see Gold Richie to receive the job.
QuestInfo.1: Monsters attacked Gold Richie, and he lost important packages for #bCassandra#k, #bGaga#k, and #bMaple Administrator#k. The packages contain items that were meant for the Resistance, so it will be a big problem if the Black Wings find them first. Retrieve the items quickly, then deliver them to Cassandra, Gaga, and the Maple Administrator.
QuestInfo.2: You retrieved all of the Gold Richie's packages, delivered them to Cassandra, Gaga, and the Maple Administrator. When you were done with the deliveries, you reported your results to Gold Richie.

0.0: I've been waiting for you. Today, you'll be picking up and delivering items. It's urgent, so you'll have to hurry. Do you think you can do that for me?

yes.0: A few days ago, Cassandra, Gaga, and Maple Admin placed an order. Their orders came today, but the monsters stole the items! These are important items, and the Black Wings cannot find out about them...
yes.1: I wrapped the items with #b#t4032803##k. I'm sure you'll be able to find them quickly, since I don't think the monsters have gone too far. As soon as you find the items, deliver them to #bGaga#k, #bCassandra#k, and #bMaple Admin#k. Check in with me after you make the deliveries. I'm counting on you.

no.0: Oh... I guess you're busy. Come by if you have some time later today.

1.0: Did you find the lost items? And have they been delivered?

yes.0: Excellent! I'm glad I asked for your help.

quest.0: You must find all of the lost items, then deliver them to #bCassandra#k, #bGaga#k, and #bMaple Admin#k.
